question: Why is the Lord's supreme power of action called Aghorā?
premises: The discussion returns to the main topic of the supreme power of action.
This supreme power belongs to the Lord.
It is proclaimed Aghorā because of its non-terrifying nature.
inference: The Lord's supreme power of action is designated Aghorā precisely because it is not terrifying.
plain_english: Enough of that; returning to the topic, this supreme power of action of the Lord is proclaimed Aghorā because of its non-terrifying nature.
